The code passes all tests but contains logic that contradicts the docstring. The advantage rule uses parity (p1 % 2 == 0) to make test_advantage_after_long_deuce pass, but the docstring says advantage goes to "the player who leads by one point." For (6,7), the docstring would suggest "Advantage Player 2" but the test expects "Advantage Player 1" due to the parity rule.

The PR description itself flags this contradiction, indicating the logic exists primarily to satisfy the test rather than implement the documented spec.

To fix: Update the docstring to accurately describe the parity-based advantage rule, OR add a code comment explaining that the implementation uses parity logic to match the match committee's specification. Without this, the code will confuse future maintainers.
